subject: EU hosting boundary evidence and private-link / VPC controls
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <security@helixhealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@helixhealth.com
Date: 2026-12-12T13:18:00+00:00
Subject: Initial request: EU hosting boundary evidence and VPC connectivity

Hi Kimberly,

We're finalizing Helix Health's vendor review for the upcoming deployment and need a compact evidence package that confirms EU-only hosting options and private-network controls. Specifically: 

- Confirmation of physical region(s) where customer data and models are hosted for EU tenants (preferred: region identifiers).
- VPC/private deployment options: can we run Redwoods' inference in a customer VPC or with private link? Describe the connectivity model and whether a private control plane is available.
- Key management options (customer-managed KMS, HSM support) and whether keys are partitioned per tenant/region.
- Audit/log availability (egress logs, request-level traces) and typical retention windows for EU deployments.
- Any SOC 2 / SIG / CAIQ artifacts you can share or a short snapshot we can include in our security review.

If possible, please attach a short runbook or network diagram and an authoritative statement we can include in our procurement packet. Our procurement timeline is tight — would appreciate a 48-72 hour turnaround if that works.

Thanks,

Lena Ortiz
InfoSec Lead, Helix Health
security@helixhealth.com

Attachments requested: network diagram, hosting statement, runbook, SOC 2 snapshot
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Initial request: EU hosting boundary evidence and VPC connectivity

Hi Lena — thanks for the clear list. Below is a concise evidence bundle and a few operational notes; I've attached the runbook and diagrams referenced.

Summary (high level):
- EU hosting: Redwood offers EU tenant residency in eu-west-1 (primary), with optional eu-central-1 for backups/DR. Customer data and inference workloads for EU tenants are pinned to those regions unless the customer explicitly opts into cross-region replication.
- Private deployment: We support Private (customer-managed) deployments with VPC peering or PrivateLink and an option for a customer-hosted control plane. For most enterprise integrations we recommend PrivateLink + customer-managed VPC endpoints (no public egress).
- KMS: Customer-managed KMS is supported (AWS KMS & external HSMs via bring-your-own-key). Keys are logically partitioned per customer and can be restricted to region-specific key policies.
- Audit & logs: Per-request traces, token-level usage logs, and egress records are available. Standard retention for EU tenants is 13 months; extended retention can be arranged under contract.
- Compliance artifacts: Attached SOC2 snapshot and a CAIQ responses workbook we maintain for vendor assessments.

Attachments (attached to this message):
- redwood_vpc_runbook_v2.pdf (runbook: deployment steps, endpoints, security controls)
- eu_region_network_map.png (illustrative architecture and PrivateLink flow)
- SOC2-snapshot-2025.pdf (extracted controls relevant to hosting/residency)
- redwood_caiaq_responses_2026.xlsx (CAIQ answers mapped to Helix questions)

Next steps: happy to fill any additional SIG-specific items and can produce a signed hosting statement for procurement. If you want, we can schedule a 30-minute handoff call with our infra team (Rishi & Vivek) tomorrow.

Regards,

Kimberly Park
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

--

Hi Lena / Kimberly — looping in a couple clarifications from the infra side.

Quick answers:
- Egress logging: Yes — egress metadata (destination IP, bytes, timestamp, originating tenant) is recorded. We can export egress logs to a customer S3 bucket in-region or to a designated SIEM via secure delivery.
- Dedicated hardware / BYOK: Private deployments can be configured on dedicated GPU pools (reserved capacity) and support BYOK where keys never leave the customer's KMS. For HSM-backed workflows we provide an HSM gateway for signing and key usage events.
- Audit retention: Default 13 months for EU tenants; the retention policy is configurable and we can put a contractual addendum for 36 months if required for audit purposes.

I have attached a terse egress policy excerpt and a runbook snippet for PrivateLink configuration to help procurement/security review.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference
